text:
devin: quick thought thinking about adding a "grace window" slider in the fallback UX. operator picks 0-30s where we keep preferring primary model before switching. pros/cons?

maria: +1. need to clarify if this counts towards client timeout or is orthogonal. also we should surface latency vs error triggers separately.

sam: default to 5s feels good. include a tiny ? tooltip: 'prefer primary for this duration; may increase p95'. also: a console "simulate spike" button to preview behavior.

devin: good call. imagine 3 degrade modes: soft (cached/partial), trim (shorter response), failfast (immediate fallback). maybe better names needed.

olivia: prefer plain names for runbooks: keep_trying, partial_return, immediate_fallback. makes sense for on-call docs.

ops-bot: FYI: feature flag enabled -> fallback_grace_v2 rollout = 20% orgs

maria: telemetry table: record event {trigger_reason, chosen_mode, latency_ms_at_trigger, tokens_emitted_primary, tokens_emitted_fallback, sample_output_id}. sampling rate configurable per org.

sam: audit retention proposal: store sampled raw outputs 90 days by default; provide UI replay and diff. must gate raw-output viewing to SRE/product via RBAC.

devin: UX: should the console show a small inline pill on requests that fell back: e.g., 'fell back: latency (5.2s) • why' with link to trace? I think yes.

olivia: add CTA in pill: "compare with primary" -> open side-by-side diff in trace viewer. important for postmortems.

maria: API change suggestion: add response header X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=keep_trying;trigger=latency;trace=abc123 when fallback occurred. also include body fallback_meta if requested.

sam: example curl for header:

    curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
      -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
      https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# headers -> X-Redwood-Fallback: mode=trim;trigger=error_rate;trace=trc_987
devin: default sampling numbers? ops-bot suggests org-wide 0.1% sampled traces; for experiment cohorts bump to 5%.

ops-bot: enacted: sampling_rate=0.1% / experiment_cohort=5% (tags: fallback_expt=true)

maria: followups: I'll draft runbook copy and console tooltip strings. also will add RBAC matrix for who can see raw traces.

sam: add unit tests for header emitted and console pill rendering; e2e to simulate delay and ensure correct mode chosen.

devin: thanks. I'll wire up a mock UI and drop screenshot in the thread later.

olivia: also recommend a hidden "panic" operator toggle to force failfast globally for incident mitigation.

maria: add to action items: 1) telemetry schema PR 2) API header + body field spec 3) console pill + compare flow 4) RBAC review 5) experiment rollout plan

devin: cool. assigning tasks in GH after this. thanks all.
